insights.title: Can the Fed Fight Inflation Without Hurting Farmers?
insights.title_zh: 芝加哥联储主席古尔斯比走访伊利诺伊农场：关税与柴油成本挤压农户，供应冲击或需美联储回应
insights.summary_zh: 芝加哥联储主席古尔斯比在伊利诺伊州农村调研，农户反映关税压低作物价格、柴油价格同比上涨约80%、化肥与种子成本上升，利润受挤压。古尔斯比表示，过去五六年的大型供应冲击对通胀的影响比最初估计更持久，若供应冲击持续推高通胀，美联储不能忽视。
insights.summary_en: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee toured rural Illinois, where farmers reported that tariffs have pushed crop prices lower, diesel prices are roughly 80% higher than a year ago, and fertilizer and seed costs have risen, squeezing profitability. Goolsbee said the large supply shocks of the past five to six years have had more persistent inflation effects than initially estimated, and that the Fed cannot ignore persistent supply-driven inflation.
insights.detail_zh: 芝加哥联储主席古尔斯比随彭博的Michael McKee走访伊利诺伊州农村，了解第七联储区的实地经济状况。农户Troy Uphoff表示，作物价格下跌主要因关税，关税本质上是对产品征税，会压低美国农产品价格，因为其他国家会报复性加征关税，美国农民受关税打击严重。Uphoff还提到柴油价格目前约为一年前的80%涨幅，柴油、种子、化肥等投入成本上升速度快于农产品价格，过去几年农户盈利能力很低。Uphoff希望古尔斯比从农场实地而非电子表格了解农户资产负债表受低价作物影响的情况。古尔斯比表示，地区联储与当地消费者和企业直接接触，有助于在数据滞后、货币政策传导需一年以上的情况下把握转折时点的时机。对于柴油和化肥等利率政策无法影响的成本，古尔斯比称央行面对滞胀性冲击没有明显剧本；历史上中小型供应冲击自行消退的速度快于货币政策见效速度，但过去五六年从疫情供应中断、大范围关税到油价冲击，每一次对通胀的影响都比最初估计更持久。他表示，美联储已超过五年高于2%通胀目标，若供应冲击持续并威胁通胀高于目标，美联储别无选择，至少必须尝试应对和降低通胀，尽管力度和形式不必与应对需求过热相同。文章还提到，美联储主席Kevin Warsh在杰克逊霍尔会议上坚持央行仍致力于让通胀回到2%，而其主要工具是提高短期利率，这可能加重已面临高成本的农户的借贷负担。古尔斯比还回应了美联储官员讲话过多的批评，认为需要更多向公众解释美联储是谁、做什么。
insights.detail_en: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee toured rural Illinois with Bloomberg's Michael McKee to hear about the economy on the ground in the Seventh Fed District. Farmer Troy Uphoff said crop prices are lower mainly due to tariffs, which he described as a tax on a product that lowers U.S. prices because other countries retaliate with their own tariffs; American farmers have been hit very hard by tariffs. Uphoff said diesel fuel is roughly 80% higher than a year ago, and that diesel, seed and fertilizer costs have risen faster than commodity prices, leaving farmers with little profitability for the past couple of years. Uphoff wanted Goolsbee to hear directly from the farm, not from a spreadsheet, about how lower commodity prices have affected growers' balance sheets. Goolsbee said direct contact with consumers and businesses in the region helps the Fed get the timing right at moments of transition, given lagged data and the year-plus lag of monetary policy. On costs such as diesel and fertilizer that rate moves won't affect, Goolsbee said the nightmare for a central bank is facing stagflationary shocks because there is no obvious playbook; historically small to medium supply shocks went away faster than monetary policy works, but over the past five to six years, from Covid supply disruption to big tariffs to big oil price shocks, each has had a substantially more persistent impact on inflation than first estimates suggested. He said inflation has been above the 2% target for more than five years, and if supply shocks are persistent and threaten to drive inflation above target, the Fed has no choice but to at least try to address and reduce inflation, though not necessarily with the same magnitude or form as fighting overheated demand. The article also noted that Fed Chair Kevin Warsh insisted at Jackson Hole that the central bank remains committed to getting inflation back to 2%, and that its main tool, raising short-term rates, can make borrowing more expensive for farmers already facing high costs. Goolsbee also responded to criticism that Fed officials speak too much, saying more demystification of what the Fed is and does is needed.
insights.conclusion_zh: 古尔斯比的表态显示，供应端冲击的持续性正成为美联储决策的重要考量，若通胀持续高于目标，即便源于供应面，美联储也可能不得不回应，这构成利率路径的上行风险。
insights.conclusion_en: Goolsbee's remarks suggest the persistence of supply-side shocks is a key consideration for the Fed; if inflation stays above target even from supply-side sources, the Fed may have to respond, posing upside risk to the rate path.

key_points.zh: 农户称作物价格下跌主要因关税，关税本质是产品税并招致报复，美国农民受打击严重。
key_points.en: Farmers say lower crop prices are mainly due to tariffs, which act as a tax on products and invite retaliation, hitting American farmers hard.

key_points.zh: 柴油价格目前约为一年前的80%涨幅，叠加种子、化肥成本上升快于农产品价格，农户过去几年盈利很低。
key_points.en: Diesel is roughly 80% higher than a year ago, and with seed and fertilizer costs rising faster than commodity prices, farmers have had little profitability for the past couple of years.

key_points.zh: 古尔斯比称过去五六年疫情供应中断、大范围关税、油价冲击等供应冲击对通胀的影响比最初估计更持久。
key_points.en: Goolsbee said supply shocks over the past five to six years—Covid disruption, big tariffs, oil price shocks—have had more persistent inflation effects than initially estimated.

key_points.zh: 古尔斯比表示美联储已超过五年高于2%通胀目标，若供应冲击持续威胁通胀，美联储别无选择必须尝试应对。
key_points.en: Goolsbee said inflation has been above the 2% target for more than five years, and if supply shocks persist and threaten inflation, the Fed has no choice but to try to address it.

key_points.zh: 美联储主席Warsh在杰克逊霍尔重申致力于让通胀回到2%，而加息工具可能加重农户借贷成本。
key_points.en: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reaffirmed at Jackson Hole the commitment to returning inflation to 2%, while the rate tool can raise borrowing costs for farmers.

insights.title: AI Selloff Tests Investor Confidence
insights.title_zh: Ritholtz：AI交易进入分化期，赢家难辨；特斯拉估值与基本面脱节
insights.summary_zh: Barry Ritholtz 认为，CoreWeave 的波动反映的是市场对 AI 交易整体 nervous 情绪，而非单一事件；AI 作为变革性技术必然产生赢家与输家，且难以提前判断。他质疑英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋的乐观表态因其并非利益中立方，并以宽带建设泡沫类比 AI 基础设施投资。对于特斯拉与 SpaceX 合并传闻，他认为特斯拉估值已与基本面脱节，且产品推出迟缓、面临比亚迪竞争。
insights.summary_en: Barry Ritholtz argues that CoreWeave's volatility reflects broader market nervousness about the AI trade rather than a single event; as a transformational technology, AI will inevitably produce winners and losers that are hard to predict in advance. He questions Jensen Huang's optimistic comments given his non-neutral position, and draws parallels to the broadband buildout bubble. On a potential Tesla-SpaceX merger, he says Tesla's valuation is disconnected from fundamentals, with slow product rollouts and rising competition from BYD.
insights.detail_zh: Ritholtz 指出，围绕 AI 交易存在诸多交叉因素，CoreWeave 的波动被归因于油价、收益率及其自身债务，但他认为更广泛的问题是市场自 2009 年低点以来已大幅上涨，投资者开始紧张。市场历史表明，每次新技术出现都会伴随赢家、输家和大量错配，目前尚不清楚生成式、代理式、基于 token 等哪些 AI 方向最终能盈利。他认为更大的威胁来自 DeepSeek 等开源 AI 系统，而非 AI 无法赚钱；Cantor Fitzgerald 称 2027 年数据中心产能已售罄，说明资金并非问题，关键在于哪些公司能存活。对于黄仁勋“一切都会过去”的表态，Ritholtz 称其并非利益中立方，但认同技术转型不可逆、新闻噪音不改变基本面。他以宽带建设为例，Juniper、Global Crossing、Metro Media Fiber 等公司破产，但廉价宽带资产催生了 YouTube、Netflix 等赢家，AI 可能类似，但赢家难以猜测，需放眼五到十年。关于特斯拉与 SpaceX 合并传闻，他称飞行汽车是噱头；特斯拉五年前领先十年，但如今估值假设其拥有 80% 电动车市场份额、市值是丰田五倍，而利润率仅为丰田八分之一，估值脱节。特斯拉新产品推出迟缓，比亚迪在续航、马力、价格上占优，正进入欧洲和加拿大，存在产品倾销担忧。
insights.detail_en: Ritholtz notes many crosscurrents around the AI trade; CoreWeave's volatility was attributed to oil prices, yields and its own debt, but he sees the broader issue as a market that has run spectacularly since the 2009 lows, making investors nervous. Market history shows every new technology brings winners, losers and massive misallocation, and it is unclear which AI approaches—agentic, generative, task-based, token-based—will ultimately be profitable. He sees open-source AI systems like DeepSeek as a bigger threat than AI failing to make money; Cantor Fitzgerald said all 2027 data-center capacity was already sold out, suggesting funding is not the problem—the question is which companies survive. On Jensen Huang's 'all of this is gonna pass' comment, Ritholtz says Huang is not a disinterested party, though he agrees the platform transition is irreversible and news noise won't change fundamentals. He cites the broadband buildout: Juniper, Global Crossing and Metro Media Fiber went bankrupt, but cheap broadband assets enabled winners like YouTube and Netflix; AI may follow a similar path, but winners are nearly impossible to guess and require a five-to-ten-year view. On a potential Tesla-SpaceX merger, he calls the flying car a gimmick; Tesla was a decade ahead five years ago, but its valuation assumes 80% EV market share and a market cap five times Toyota's while its profit margin is about one-eighth of Toyota's—a disconnect. Tesla has been slow to launch new products, and BYD leads on range, horsepower and price, expanding into Europe and Canada, raising product-dumping concerns.
insights.conclusion_zh: AI 交易正从普涨转向分化，投资者应降低对单一赢家的押注，放眼五到十年并考虑指数化配置；特斯拉的估值风险与竞争压力值得警惕。
insights.conclusion_en: The AI trade is shifting from broad gains to differentiation; investors should reduce bets on single winners, take a five-to-ten-year view and consider indexing, while Tesla's valuation risk and competitive pressure warrant caution.

key_points.zh: CoreWeave 波动反映的是市场对 AI 交易的整体紧张情绪，而非孤立事件；AI 技术变革必然产生赢家与输家，且难以提前判断。
key_points.en: CoreWeave's volatility reflects broad market nervousness about the AI trade, not an isolated event; AI disruption will inevitably create winners and losers that are hard to predict.

key_points.zh: Ritholtz 认为开源 AI（如 DeepSeek）是更大威胁，而非 AI 无法盈利；Cantor Fitzgerald 称 2027 年数据中心产能已售罄，资金不是问题。
key_points.en: Ritholtz sees open-source AI like DeepSeek as a bigger threat than AI failing to make money; Cantor Fitzgerald says 2027 data-center capacity is sold out, so funding is not the issue.

key_points.zh: 黄仁勋的乐观表态因其非利益中立方而需谨慎看待，但 Ritholtz 认同技术转型不可逆、新闻噪音不改变基本面。
key_points.en: Jensen Huang's optimism should be viewed cautiously given his non-neutral position, though Ritholtz agrees the platform transition is irreversible and news noise won't change fundamentals.

key_points.zh: 以宽带建设泡沫为鉴：大量公司破产，但廉价资产催生了 YouTube、Netflix 等赢家；AI 赢家需放眼五到十年，指数化投资是合理选择。
key_points.en: The broadband bubble saw many bankruptcies but cheap assets enabled winners like YouTube and Netflix; AI winners require a five-to-ten-year view, making indexing a reasonable approach.

key_points.zh: 特斯拉估值与基本面脱节：假设 80% 电动车份额、市值为丰田五倍，但利润率仅为丰田八分之一；产品推出迟缓，比亚迪在续航、马力、价格上占优。
key_points.en: Tesla's valuation is disconnected from fundamentals: it assumes 80% EV share and a market cap five times Toyota's while its margin is one-eighth of Toyota's; product launches are slow and BYD leads on range, horsepower and price.

insights.title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
insights.title_zh: 特斯拉Roadster原型亮相与退休储蓄焦虑：市场杂谈
insights.summary_zh: 特斯拉发布延迟已久的Roadster跑车原型，设计包含SpaceX空气推进器，但量产要等到2028年，引发市场对其真实性和实用性的质疑。同时，美国退休者因担忧储蓄耗尽而推迟享受生活，超六成拥有至少50万美元可投资资产的退休者不愿为享乐花钱。
insights.summary_en: Tesla unveiled a prototype of its long-delayed Roadster sports car, featuring SpaceX air thrusters, but production isn't until 2028, raising questions about its authenticity and practicality. Meanwhile, U.S. retirees are postponing enjoyment to protect savings, with over 60% of those with $500,000+ in investable assets uncomfortable spending on enjoyment.
insights.detail_zh: 特斯拉发布了延迟已久的Roadster跑车原型，该车设计包含SpaceX的空气推进器，可使车辆在空中翻转。视频引发广泛讨论，许多人质疑其真实性，认为可能是模型或特效。评论指出，这可能是将特斯拉与SpaceX更紧密联系的一种举措。两家公司都将在下周发布财报，时机引人关注。但Roadster的量产要等到2028年，且已有消费者为此支付了订金，交付仍遥遥无期。此外，一项研究显示，超过60%拥有至少50万美元可投资资产的退休者不愿为享乐花钱，超过一半的人最大担忧是“人活着钱没了”。成本上升、寿命延长以及社保福利可能被削减是主要顾虑。
insights.detail_en: Tesla unveiled a prototype of its long-delayed Roadster sports car, designed with SpaceX air thrusters that allow it to flip in mid-air. The video sparked widespread discussion, with many questioning its authenticity, suggesting it might be a model or special effect. Commentators noted it could be a move to bring Tesla and SpaceX closer together. Both companies are reporting earnings next week, a notable timing. However, Roadster production isn't until 2028, and customers who have already put money down are still waiting. Additionally, a study shows more than 60% of retirees with $500,000+ in investable assets are uncomfortable spending on enjoyment, and more than half cite running out of money before death as their biggest concern. Rising costs, longer lifespans, and potential Social Security benefit cuts are key worries.

key_points.zh: 特斯拉Roadster原型亮相，配备SpaceX空气推进器，但量产要等到2028年。
key_points.en: Tesla's Roadster prototype features SpaceX air thrusters, but production is not until 2028.

key_points.zh: 视频引发真实性争议，许多人质疑其是否为模型或特效。
key_points.en: The video sparked authenticity debates, with many questioning if it's a model or CGI.

key_points.zh: 特斯拉和SpaceX均将于下周发布财报，时机引人关注。
key_points.en: Both Tesla and SpaceX are reporting earnings next week, drawing attention to the timing.

key_points.zh: 超六成拥有至少50万美元可投资资产的退休者不愿为享乐花钱，最大担忧是“人活着钱没了”。
key_points.en: Over 60% of retirees with $500k+ investable assets are reluctant to spend on enjoyment, with the biggest fear being running out of money.

key_points.zh: 成本上升、寿命延长及社保福利可能削减是退休者的主要顾虑。
key_points.en: Rising costs, longer lifespans, and potential Social Security cuts are key retiree concerns.

insights.title: Rockstar Rebuilt Itself to Make GTA VI
insights.title_zh: GTA 6 定档11月19日：开发投入约20亿美元，首销预期超30亿美元
insights.summary_zh: Rockstar 的《侠盗猎车手6》定于11月19日发售，开发历时十余年、投入约20亿美元，被视为史上最大规模游戏发售。分析师预计其首几个月销量约4000万份、收入超30亿美元；Rockstar 为缓解“crunch”（过度加班）将团队规模从2400人扩至4700人，并推出“time in lieu”补休制度，但受访员工仍对能否兑现补休存疑。
insights.summary_en: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI is set for a November 19 release after more than a decade of development and roughly $2 billion invested, billed as the biggest video game launch ever. Analysts estimate it could sell about 40 million copies in its first few months, generating more than $3 billion in revenue; to mitigate 'crunch,' Rockstar doubled its studio from 2,400 to 4,700 people and introduced 'time in lieu' paid time off, though some employees are skeptical the extra time will materialize.
insights.detail_zh: 《侠盗猎车手6》是 Rockstar 旗下 GTA 系列第六部，定于11月19日正式发售，开发超过十年、投入约20亿美元，被预期为史上最大规模的游戏发售。上一部 GTA 5 于2013年发售，销量达2.3亿份，是史上最畅销的非移动游戏；Rockstar 在两者之间于2018年推出了《荒野大镖客2》，此后才全力投入本作。2018年至当前，Rockstar 员工规模从2400人翻倍至4700人，公司为此搭建了中层管理和制作团队；扩编部分源于《荒野大镖客2》发售后围绕“crunch”（过度加班）的争议。为缓解加班，公司称改善了排期与工作量衡量，并推出“time in lieu”——每加班一小时可换取一小时带薪休假，但受访员工对项目结束后能否真正兑现补休存疑。AI 方面，Rockstar 表示本项目未使用 AI，未来尚不确定；彭博此前报道 Epic Games 正全面押注 AI。定价上，游戏售价80美元，含全部奖励的完整套餐为100美元。分析师预计本作首几个月销量约4000万份、收入超30亿美元，规模可能在数周内超过《奥德赛》全作。本作地图以佛罗里达为原型，开发团队曾赴迈阿密实地考察，包括乘直升机勘察城市鸟瞰、参加警察随行、与罪犯会面等。本作也是 Rockstar 现代作品中首次采用女性主角。
insights.detail_en: Grand Theft Auto VI, the sixth installment in Rockstar's GTA series, is set for an official November 19 release after more than a decade of development and roughly $2 billion invested, and is expected to be the biggest video game launch ever. The prior title, GTA 5, released in 2013 and sold 230 million copies, making it the best-selling non-mobile game of all time; Rockstar released Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018 in between, and has been in full production on this game since then. Between 2018 and now, Rockstar doubled in size from 2,400 to 4,700 employees, building out a layer of middle management and a production team; the expansion was partly driven by the controversy over 'crunch' (excessive overtime) after Red Dead Redemption 2's release. To mitigate crunch, the company says it improved scheduling and workload measurement and introduced 'time in lieu'—one hour of paid time off for every extra hour worked—though some employees are skeptical the extra time will materialize when the project ends. On AI, Rockstar says it has not used AI on this project and the future is uncertain; Bloomberg earlier reported that Epic Games is all in on AI. On pricing, the game costs $80, with a $100 full package including bonuses. Analysts estimate it will sell about 40 million copies in its first few months, generating more than $3 billion in revenue—potentially bigger than the entirety of The Odyssey in just a few weeks. The map is based on Florida, and top developers took a research trip to Miami, including a helicopter ride to scope aerial views, police ride-alongs and meetings with criminals. It is also Rockstar's first modern game with a female protagonist.
insights.conclusion_zh: GTA 6 有望成为史上最大规模游戏发售，其首销数据与定价策略是观察 Rockstar 母公司 Take-Two 短期业绩弹性的关键变量。
insights.conclusion_en: GTA VI is poised to be the biggest game launch ever, and its initial sales and pricing will be key variables for near-term earnings leverage at Rockstar's parent Take-Two.

key_points.zh: GTA 6 定于11月19日发售，开发超十年、投入约20亿美元，被预期为史上最大游戏发售。
key_points.en: GTA VI is set for a November 19 release after more than a decade of development and about $2 billion invested, expected to be the biggest game launch ever.

key_points.zh: 分析师预计首几个月销量约4000万份、收入超30亿美元；前作 GTA 5 销量2.3亿份，为史上最畅销非移动游戏。
key_points.en: Analysts estimate about 40 million copies sold in the first few months and more than $3 billion in revenue; predecessor GTA 5 sold 230 million copies, the best-selling non-mobile game ever.

key_points.zh: Rockstar 员工从2400人增至4700人，并推出“time in lieu”补休制度以缓解 crunch，但部分员工对兑现存疑。
key_points.en: Rockstar grew from 2,400 to 4,700 employees and introduced 'time in lieu' paid time off to mitigate crunch, though some employees doubt it will be honored.

key_points.zh: Rockstar 称本项目未使用 AI；彭博报道 Epic Games 正全面押注 AI。
key_points.en: Rockstar says it has not used AI on this project; Bloomberg reported Epic Games is all in on AI.

key_points.zh: 游戏定价80美元，含全部奖励的完整套餐100美元；本作首次采用女性主角，地图以佛罗里达为原型。
key_points.en: The game costs $80, with a $100 full package including bonuses; it features a female protagonist for the first time and a Florida-based map.

insights.title: We Asked a $17B International Manager Why Value is Winning Again — and What the S&P 500 Leaves Out
insights.title_zh: 价值投资老将复盘：从深度价值到质量复利，再到动态风险仪表盘
insights.summary_zh: T. Rowe Price全球股票投资组合经理Colin回顾其自1989年以来的价值投资生涯，总结出三条经验：深度价值需要情绪韧性、质量复利适用于无形资产主导的经济、以及通过估值离散度和绝对便宜程度构建自上而下的风险仪表盘来动态管理风险。他强调价值投资并非静态策略，而需在极端便宜且心理压力最大时加大风险暴露。
insights.summary_en: Colin, a portfolio manager at T. Rowe Price's global equity division, reflects on his value investing career since 1989, distilling three lessons: deep value requires emotional resilience, quality compounding applies to an intangible-asset-driven economy, and a top-down risk dashboard tracking valuation dispersion and absolute cheapness helps dynamically manage risk. He stresses that value investing is not static and requires ramping up risk when stocks are extremely cheap and psychological pressure is highest.
insights.detail_zh: Colin于1989年在英国Phillips and Drew基金管理部门开始职业生涯，该机构以深度价值投资著称，他形容其理念为“在垃圾桶里翻找别人扔掉的东西”。这段经历让他掌握了价值投资的工具与技巧，更重要的是一种情绪韧性——在收件箱充满负面观点时仍能舒适地买入。他职业生涯前半段正值价值投资持续跑赢的时期，他一度疑惑为何并非人人采用价值策略；后半段则艰难地得到了答案。离开UBS后他加入摩根士丹利全球价值团队，从“深度脏价值”一端转向“质量复利”一端，最初六个月对高估值感到困惑，但逐渐认识到基于品牌、技术等无形资产的思考框架更适用于日益无形的经济，而传统格雷厄姆式框架更侧重硬资产。他在全球金融危机结束时离开摩根士丹利，加入英国精品机构T. Rowe Price（原文为“Tro”，疑为T. Rowe Price）设立价值股票基金，恰逢价值投资自大萧条以来最差的十年。他从中学习到个人韧性、区分结构性vs周期性逆风，并发现价值在逆境中仍有阶段性表现但缺乏持续性。他由此开发了一套自上而下的风险仪表盘，采用红绿灯指标跟踪市场估值离散度，寻找“失宠者极度失宠”且绝对估值便宜的条件，以类似21点算牌的方式动态管理风险——在牌面有利时重注，不利时收敛。
insights.detail_en: Colin began his career in 1989 at Phillips and Drew Fund Management in the UK, a firm synonymous with deep value investing, whose motto he paraphrased as 'fishing in the garbage cans for things others have thrown out.' That experience taught him the tools and techniques of value investing, but more importantly emotional resilience—being comfortable buying when your inbox is full of people explaining why a stock is awful. The first half of his career coincided with a period when value investing worked, and he wondered why not everyone did it; the second half taught him the answer the hard way. After leaving UBS, he joined Morgan Stanley's global value team, moving from the 'deep and dirty value' end to the 'quality compounding' end. Initially puzzled for six months about why they paid so much for stocks, he came to see a different thought process suited to companies built on intangible assets like brands and technology, whereas the Graham school he grew up in focused on hard assets. He left Morgan Stanley at the end of the GFC and joined a UK boutique (referred to as 'Tro', likely T. Rowe Price) to set up a value equity fund, launching just into what was probably the worst decade for value outside the Great Depression. He learned about personal resilience, distinguishing structural versus cyclical drivers of out-of-favor businesses, and observed that even during value's underperformance there were spurts when value worked but not durably. This led him to develop a top-down risk dashboard with traffic-light indicators tracking valuation dispersion, looking for conditions where what was out of favor was really out of favor and absolutely cheap, and to manage risk dynamically like counting cards at a blackjack table—betting heavily when the deck is favorable and keeping cards closer to the chest otherwise.
insights.conclusion_zh: 价值投资并非静态策略，需结合自下而上的个股选择与自上而下的风险仪表盘，在极端便宜且心理压力最大时动态加大风险暴露。
insights.conclusion_en: Value investing is not a static strategy; it requires combining bottom-up stock selection with a top-down risk dashboard to dynamically increase risk exposure when assets are extremely cheap and psychological pressure is highest.

key_points.zh: 深度价值投资的核心挑战在于情绪韧性：在负面信息充斥时仍能坚持买入。
key_points.en: The core challenge of deep value investing is emotional resilience: buying when negative information is overwhelming.

key_points.zh: 从深度价值转向质量复利，反映了经济中无形资产占比上升的现实。
key_points.en: The shift from deep value to quality compounding reflects the rising share of intangible assets in the economy.

key_points.zh: 价值投资在长期跑赢后可能经历长期低迷，需区分结构性vs周期性逆风。
key_points.en: Value investing can experience prolonged underperformance after long outperformance; distinguishing structural vs cyclical headwinds is key.

key_points.zh: 自上而下的风险仪表盘跟踪估值离散度和绝对便宜程度，帮助动态调整风险暴露。
key_points.en: A top-down risk dashboard tracking valuation dispersion and absolute cheapness helps dynamically adjust risk exposure.

key_points.zh: 最佳买入时机往往是心理压力最大、失宠资产极度失宠且绝对估值便宜之时。
key_points.en: The best buying opportunities often occur when psychological pressure is highest and out-of-favor assets are extremely cheap in absolute terms.

insights.title: The EV Bust Creating a New Battery Boom
insights.title_zh: 特朗普政策意外推动储能电池发展：电动车补贴退坡，电池制造商转向电网储能
insights.summary_zh: 特朗普政府对电动车支持减弱，却意外为电网储能电池创造发展契机。电池制造商正将车用电池产能转向大型储能系统，联邦税收优惠和本土制造要求进一步推动该趋势。Wood Mackenzie数据显示美国电池储能年装机量五年增长16倍，但供应链重组可能导致2026-2027年增速暂时放缓。
insights.summary_en: The Trump administration's reduced support for EVs has inadvertently created an opportunity for grid-scale battery storage. Battery manufacturers are pivoting from EV cells to large-scale storage systems, aided by federal tax incentives and domestic manufacturing requirements. Wood Mackenzie data shows U.S. battery storage annual installations grew 16x in five years, though supply chain restructuring may slow growth in 2026-2027.
insights.detail_zh: 特朗普总统对可再生能源持怀疑态度，但削减电动车支持的政策却可能推动风能和太阳能取得实质进展。电池储能系统（BESS）解决了可再生能源无法按需调度的核心局限。随着数据中心、新工厂和用电高峰增加对按需电力的需求，储能的灵活性价值日益凸显。尽管政府缩减对风能和太阳能的直接支持，电池仍符合联邦税收激励资格，包括使用美国制造组件的额外优惠。8月，特朗普签署行政令，针对电网设备（包括电池储能）对外国制造的依赖，推动能源开发商转向美国制造。LG Energy Solution在密歇根州兰辛的工厂是其北美5个电芯工厂之一，满产年产能预计超过35吉瓦时，同时服务电动车和电网储能。Wood Mackenzie的Allison Weis表示，美国电池储能年装机量已从1.2吉瓦增至去年的19吉瓦，增长16倍。但2025年美国仍从中国进口59%的锂离子电池，新采购规则迫使开发商重建供应链，预计2026和2027年增速将略低于原本水平。特朗普的“One Big Beautiful Bill”保留了部分激励措施，但于2025年9月终止了联邦电动车税收抵免，导致电动车销量下降、需求前景走弱。电池制造商并未减记资产，而是将相同的制造工艺和设备转向储能产品。通用汽车和福特正将部分电池业务转向固定式储能，特斯拉也在扩大电网储能业务。
insights.detail_en: President Trump has been skeptical of government support for renewable energy, but efforts to cut back on EVs may be just what's needed to advance wind and solar. Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) help close the gap of renewable energy running on nature's schedule rather than the grid's. Flexibility is becoming more valuable as data centers, new factories, and electricity spikes increase the need for on-demand power. Even as the administration scales back support for wind and solar, batteries remain eligible for federal tax incentives, including an additional benefit for projects using US-made components. In August, President Trump issued an executive order targeting reliance on foreign-made grid equipment, including battery storage, pushing developers toward US-made alternatives. LG Energy Solution's Lansing, Michigan plant is one of five cell facilities in North America, expected to reach more than 35 GWh of annual capacity at full output for both EVs and grid storage. Allison Weis of Wood Mackenzie said annual US battery storage installations grew from 1.2 GW to 19 GW last year, a 16x increase. However, as of 2025 the US still imported 59% of its lithium-ion batteries from China, and new sourcing rules are forcing developers to rebuild supply chains, with less growth forecast for 2026 and 2027. Trump's One Big Beautiful Bill preserved some incentives but ended federal EV credits in September 2025, causing EV sales to fall and demand outlook to weaken. Manufacturers are pivoting rather than writing off assets, using the same manufacturing processes for ESS. GM and Ford are redirecting parts of their battery operations toward stationary storage, while Tesla expands its grid storage business.
insights.conclusion_zh: 政策意外催生储能电池投资机会：电动车补贴退坡反而加速电池制造商转向电网储能，本土制造税收优惠和供应链重组将重塑行业格局，但2026-2027年增速可能暂时放缓。
insights.conclusion_en: Policy unintendedly creates storage battery investment opportunities: EV subsidy rollback accelerates manufacturers' pivot to grid storage, with domestic manufacturing incentives and supply chain restructuring reshaping the industry, though growth may temporarily slow in 2026-2027.

key_points.zh: 美国电池储能年装机量五年内从1.2吉瓦增至19吉瓦，增长16倍。
key_points.en: US annual battery storage installations grew 16x in five years, from 1.2 GW to 19 GW.

key_points.zh: 2025年美国仍从中国进口59%的锂离子电池，新采购规则迫使供应链重组，预计2026-2027年增速暂时放缓。
key_points.en: The US still imported 59% of lithium-ion batteries from China in 2025; new sourcing rules force supply chain restructuring, with slower growth expected in 2026-2027.

key_points.zh: 联邦电动车税收抵免于2025年9月终止，导致电动车销量下降，电池制造商将产能转向电网储能。
key_points.en: Federal EV tax credits ended in September 2025, causing EV sales to fall and manufacturers to pivot capacity toward grid storage.

key_points.zh: LG Energy Solution兰辛工厂满产年产能预计超过35吉瓦时，可同时生产电动车和储能电芯。
key_points.en: LG Energy Solution's Lansing plant is expected to reach over 35 GWh annual capacity, producing both EV and ESS cells.

key_points.zh: 通用汽车和福特正将部分电池业务转向固定式储能，特斯拉也在扩大电网储能业务。
key_points.en: GM and Ford are redirecting parts of their battery operations toward stationary storage, while Tesla expands its grid storage business.

insights.title: Trump Puts New Russia Sanctions on Hold
insights.title_zh: 特朗普豁免对俄能源制裁以压低柴油价格，乌克兰与欧洲不满
insights.summary_zh: 特朗普总统豁免了原定数日内生效的对俄能源出口制裁，并推动俄罗斯柴油重返全球市场，旨在中期选举前压低柴油价格。俄方视此为制裁进一步放松的信号，而乌克兰与欧洲则感到失望，认为放松压力无助于促使普京谈判。
insights.summary_en: President Trump waived sanctions on Russian energy exports that were set to take effect within days and worked with Putin to release Russian diesel into the global market, aiming to lower diesel prices ahead of the midterms. Moscow sees this as a signal of further sanctions relief, while Ukraine and Europe are dismayed, arguing that easing pressure won't bring Putin to the table.
insights.detail_zh: 特朗普总统豁免了原定数日内生效的、针对俄罗斯官员和寡头的制裁，该制裁属于上月签署的法律，该法律由已故参议员林赛·格雷厄姆推动。此举叠加了特朗普与普京合作释放俄罗斯柴油供应的决定。彭博社编辑Anthony Halpin指出，战前俄罗斯占全球海运柴油约10%，现在将试图恢复该市场份额；对克里姆林宫而言，柴油交易虽无直接预算收益，但企业售油后税收终将入账，且提供了进一步制裁放松的希望。Halpin表示，俄方对特朗普的决定感到乐观，认为可能开启更多俄美协议。与此同时，乌克兰对特朗普被视为偏袒俄罗斯感到极大沮丧；欧洲盟友认为只有加大压力才能让普京谈判，但白宫似乎认为放松压力可诱使普京同意谈判，然而没有迹象表明该策略奏效。彭博社白宫记者Jeff Mason称，特朗普在中期选举前民调落后，正赴红州助选，柴油价格是导致其支持率低迷的因素之一，因此与俄罗斯的柴油交易及豁免制裁主要出于国内政治考量。欧洲在峰会上承诺增加对乌支持，尤其是防空系统，但乌克兰仍严重依赖美国情报（如SpaceX的星盾网络）和武器，欧洲难以轻易替代。
insights.detail_en: President Trump waived sanctions on Russian officials and oligarchs that were set to take effect within days, part of a law signed last month championed by the late Senator Lindsey Graham. This comes on top of Trump's decision to work with Putin to release Russian diesel supply into the global market. Anthony Halpin, Bloomberg's Russia and economy government editor, noted that Russia accounted for about 10% of global seaborne diesel before the war and will now try to restore its position; while there is no direct immediate benefit to the state budget, companies will sell the diesel and taxes will eventually be paid, and the deal provides hope for further sanctions relief. Halpin said the Kremlin is optimistic that Trump's decision could open the way to more agreements between Russia and the US. Meanwhile, Ukraine is dismayed by what it sees as Trump siding with Putin, the aggressor; Ukraine and European allies have consistently argued that only increased pressure can bring Putin to the table, but the White House appears to believe that relaxing pressure may tempt him to negotiate—with no sign of that working. Jeff Mason, Bloomberg News White House correspondent, said Trump is underwater ahead of the midterms and is doing campaign stops in red states; diesel prices are one factor hurting him, making domestic politics the primary reason for the waiver. Europe pledged more support for Ukraine, especially air defenses, at a summit, but Ukraine remains heavily reliant on US intelligence (such as SpaceX's Star Shield network) and US weaponry, which Europe cannot easily replace.
insights.conclusion_zh: 特朗普为压低柴油价格、应对中期选举而放松对俄制裁，短期或缓解柴油价格压力，但地缘风险与欧洲安全格局的不确定性上升，需关注对能源市场与国防板块的传导。
insights.conclusion_en: Trump's sanctions relief to lower diesel prices ahead of the midterms may ease near-term diesel price pressure, but raises geopolitical and European security uncertainty; watch transmission to energy markets and defense sectors.

key_points.zh: 特朗普豁免了原定数日内生效的对俄能源出口制裁，该制裁针对俄官员和寡头，属于上月签署的法律。
key_points.en: Trump waived sanctions on Russian energy exports set to take effect within days, targeting Russian officials and oligarchs under a law signed last month.

key_points.zh: 俄罗斯战前占全球海运柴油约10%，柴油交易虽无直接预算收益，但税收终将入账，并带来进一步制裁放松的希望。
key_points.en: Russia accounted for about 10% of global seaborne diesel before the war; the diesel deal offers no direct budget benefit but taxes will eventually be paid and it raises hope for further sanctions relief.

key_points.zh: 乌克兰和欧洲认为只有加大压力才能促使普京谈判，但白宫似乎认为放松压力可诱使其谈判，目前无迹象表明奏效。
key_points.en: Ukraine and Europe argue only increased pressure can bring Putin to negotiate, but the White House appears to believe relaxing pressure may tempt him—with no sign of success.

key_points.zh: 特朗普在中期选举前民调落后，柴油价格是导致其支持率低迷的因素之一，豁免制裁主要出于国内政治考量。
key_points.en: Trump is underwater ahead of the midterms, with diesel prices one factor hurting him; the waiver is primarily driven by domestic politics.

key_points.zh: 欧洲承诺增加对乌支持，但乌克兰仍严重依赖美国情报（如星盾网络）和武器，欧洲难以轻易替代。
key_points.en: Europe pledged more support for Ukraine, but Ukraine remains heavily reliant on US intelligence (e.g., Star Shield) and weapons, which Europe cannot easily replace.

insights.title: What Moved Markets This Week
insights.title_zh: 美股周报：CPI超预期，科技股拖累纳指跌4.5%，VIX飙升
insights.summary_zh: 美国9月CPI同比上涨3.7%，符合预期但较8月加速；科技股持续疲软，纳指本周重挫4.48%，标普500跌1.95%，道指微涨0.67%。周五VIX一度飙升约30%至21上方，创四个多月新高；银行股开启Q3财报季。
insights.summary_en: US September CPI rose 3.7% year-over-year, in line with consensus but accelerating from August's 3.4% gain. Tech stocks remained under pressure, dragging the Nasdaq down 4.48% for the week, while the S&P 500 fell 1.95% and the Dow edged up 0.67%. The VIX surged roughly 30% on Friday afternoon to above 21, a more than four-month high, as big banks kicked off Q3 earnings season.
insights.detail_zh: 美国9月CPI同比上涨3.7%，与市场预期一致，但较8月的3.4%有所加速，显示通胀有所升温。科技股持续承压，纳指本周大跌4.48%，标普500下跌1.95%，道指则小幅上涨0.67%。周五下午，Cboe波动率指数（VIX）飙升约30%，升至21上方，创下四个多月新高，反映市场对科技股疲软的担忧加剧。Q3财报季由大型银行拉开帷幕，高盛、摩根大通、花旗、富国银行等均公布了业绩。板块方面，信息技术板块领跌，跌幅达6.4%；必需消费、能源和医疗保健板块表现较好，分别上涨5%、5%和3.4%。个股方面，Fair Isaac（FICO）大涨16%，Cognizant（CTSH）涨12%；Ciena（CIEN）、Coherent（COHR）、Lumentum（LITE）等科技股均大跌约25%。此外，美联储数据显示，2025年有五分之一的美国人未能按时偿还贷款或抵押贷款，比例高于2022年的八分之一，为2007年以来最高水平。
insights.detail_en: US September CPI rose 3.7% year-over-year, matching consensus but accelerating from 3.4% in August, indicating some heating up of inflation. Tech stocks remained under pressure, with the Nasdaq plunging 4.48% for the week, the S&P 500 falling 1.95%, while the Dow edged up 0.67%. On Friday afternoon, the Cboe Volatility Index (VIX) surged roughly 30% to trade above 21, reaching a more than four-month high, reflecting heightened concerns over tech weakness. Q3 earnings season kicked off with major banks including Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Citigroup, and Wells Fargo reporting results. By sector, Information Technology led declines with a 6.4% drop, while Consumer Staples, Energy, and Healthcare outperformed, rising 5%, 5%, and 3.4%, respectively. Among individual stocks, Fair Isaac (FICO) jumped 16% and Cognizant (CTSH) rose 12%, while Ciena (CIEN), Coherent (COHR), and Lumentum (LITE) each fell about 25%. Additionally, Federal Reserve data showed that 1 in 5 Americans fell behind on a loan or mortgage payment in 2025, up from 1 in 8 in 2022 and the highest level since 2007.
insights.conclusion_zh: 通胀加速与科技股疲软叠加，市场波动加剧，投资者需关注财报季表现及利率路径对估值的影响。
insights.conclusion_en: Accelerating inflation and tech weakness are fueling market volatility; investors should watch earnings season and the rate path for valuation implications.

key_points.zh: 美国9月CPI同比上涨3.7%，符合预期但较8月的3.4%加速。
key_points.en: US September CPI rose 3.7% YoY, in line with expectations but accelerating from 3.4% in August.

key_points.zh: 科技股疲软拖累纳指本周大跌4.48%，标普500跌1.95%，道指涨0.67%。
key_points.en: Tech weakness dragged the Nasdaq down 4.48% for the week; S&P 500 fell 1.95%, Dow rose 0.67%.

key_points.zh: 周五VIX飙升约30%至21上方，创四个多月新高。
key_points.en: The VIX surged roughly 30% on Friday to above 21, a more than four-month high.

key_points.zh: Q3财报季开启，高盛、摩根大通、花旗、富国银行等大型银行公布业绩。
key_points.en: Q3 earnings season began with results from Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Citigroup, Wells Fargo, and other major banks.

key_points.zh: 美联储数据显示，2025年五分之一的美国人未能按时偿还贷款或抵押贷款，为2007年以来最高。
key_points.en: Fed data shows 1 in 5 Americans fell behind on a loan or mortgage payment in 2025, the highest since 2007.

insights.title: Female Athletes Are Over Being Gaslit by Sneaker Giants
insights.title_zh: 女性运动鞋长期沿用男鞋缩小版，新品牌推动行业变革
insights.summary_zh: 数十年来，多数女性运动鞋实为男鞋的缩小版，行业称之为“缩小并染粉”。这种做法源于成本考量，却可能给女性带来疼痛甚至受伤。如今，一批由女性运动员和商界女性创立的新品牌正专注研发女性专属性能鞋，并推动耐克、阿迪达斯、彪马等巨头加大投入。
insights.summary_en: For decades, most women's sports shoes have essentially been smaller versions of men's shoes, an industry practice known as 'shrink it and pink it.' This approach, driven by cost savings, can cause pain and potentially injuries for women. Now, a new crop of brands founded by female athletes and businesswomen are developing female-specific performance footwear, pushing giants like Nike, Adidas, and Puma to invest more.
insights.detail_zh: 数十年来，大多数女性运动鞋基本上是男鞋的缩小版，行业内部甚至有个说法叫“缩小并染粉”（shrink it and pink it），即品牌把男鞋做小、赋予女性化外观后推向市场。但女性和男性的脚型不同，这种粗糙的做法已造成许多不必要的疼痛，甚至可能带来伤害。这种做法与体育用品行业长期推崇并营销世界顶级女性运动员的形象相矛盾。究其原因，资金是主要因素：设计和营销女性专属运动鞋并不便宜，如果公司能只专注于一个基于男性脚型的模型并称之为中性款，就能大幅削减成本。此外，专门为女性打造鞋款可能侵蚀现有畅销系列的销售，例如阿迪达斯的Anthony Edwards篮球鞋或耐克的LeBron系列。所幸情况终于开始改变。一批由女性运动员和商界女性创立的新公司正致力于为女性研发其喜爱运动项目的性能鞋，品牌如Moolah Kicks、Aidas Sports和Hedays正引领这一变革。尽管它们规模尚小，但影响巨大，赢得了客户和职业运动员的青睐，并推动包括耐克、阿迪达斯和彪马在内的巨头投入更多资源开发女性专属性能鞋。因为就性能而言，一刀切可能并不适合所有人。
insights.detail_en: For decades, most women's sports shoes have basically been men's shoes made smaller. In the industry, there's even a name for it: 'shrink it and pink it.' Brands make a men's shoe smaller, give it a feminine makeover, and take it to market. But women and men have different feet, and this rough-and-ready approach has caused a lot of unnecessary pain and potentially even injuries. The practice is at odds with the sporting goods industry that's long championed and marketed the world's top female athletes. A big factor is money: designing and marketing female-specific sports sneakers is not cheap, and if companies can get away with focusing on just one model, often based on a male foot, described as unisex, then it can cut costs dramatically. Plus, targeting women with shoes built just for them risks eating into sales of established franchises, like Adidas' Anthony Edwards basketball kicks or Nike's LeBron sneakers. Thankfully, things are finally beginning to change. A new crop of entrepreneurs, including female athletes and businesswomen, are building companies devoted entirely to developing performance footwear for women in their favorite sports. Brands like Moolah Kicks, Aidas Sports, and Hedays are leading the change. While they're still small, they're having a big impact, winning customers and pro athletes as fans and helping push giants, including Nike, Adidas, and Puma, to put more resources into making female-specific performance footwear. Because when it comes to performance, one size might not fit all.
insights.conclusion_zh: 女性专属性能鞋需求正被新品牌验证，可能促使运动巨头调整产品策略，关注相关公司的产品线创新与市场细分机会。
insights.conclusion_en: Demand for female-specific performance footwear is being validated by new brands, potentially prompting sports giants to adjust product strategies; watch for product innovation and market segmentation opportunities.

key_points.zh: 多数女性运动鞋长期沿用男鞋缩小版，行业称为“缩小并染粉”，导致疼痛甚至潜在伤害。
key_points.en: Most women's sports shoes have long been smaller versions of men's shoes, an industry practice called 'shrink it and pink it,' causing pain and potential injuries.

key_points.zh: 成本是主因：专注单一基于男性脚型的模型并称为中性款，可大幅削减设计和营销费用。
key_points.en: Cost is a major factor: focusing on a single model based on a male foot and calling it unisex can dramatically cut design and marketing costs.

key_points.zh: 为女性专门设计鞋款可能侵蚀现有畅销系列（如阿迪达斯Anthony Edwards或耐克LeBron）的销售。
key_points.en: Targeting women with female-specific shoes risks cannibalizing sales of established franchises like Adidas' Anthony Edwards or Nike's LeBron sneakers.

key_points.zh: 新品牌Moolah Kicks、Aidas Sports和Hedays正引领变革，专注女性性能鞋并赢得客户和职业运动员。
key_points.en: New brands like Moolah Kicks, Aidas Sports, and Hedays are leading the change, focusing on female performance footwear and winning customers and pro athletes.

key_points.zh: 这些新品牌正推动耐克、阿迪达斯和彪马等巨头投入更多资源开发女性专属性能鞋。
key_points.en: These new brands are pushing giants like Nike, Adidas, and Puma to put more resources into female-specific performance footwear.

insights.title: David Byrne Explains How Forgotten Ideas Come Back to Life | Odd Lots
insights.title_zh: David Byrne谈“睡美人”理念：好想法如何休眠与复苏，兼论明斯基的再发现
insights.summary_zh: 音乐人兼作家David Byrne在新书《Sleeping Beauties》中探讨了曾受关注后被遗忘、又在危机等时刻被重新发现的“睡美人”理念。他以明斯基为例，指出其行为经济学思想在2008年金融危机后被重新重视，并认为研究理念如何被重新发现有助于找到仍被埋没的宝贵想法。
insights.summary_en: Musician and author David Byrne discusses his new book 'Sleeping Beauties,' which explores ideas that receive initial attention, fade into obscurity, and are later rediscovered, often during crises. Using Hyman Minsky as an example, he notes Minsky's behavioral economics ideas were revived after the 2008 financial crisis, and argues that studying how ideas are rediscovered can help identify still-dormant valuable concepts.
insights.detail_zh: 在Odd Lots播客中，David Byrne介绍其新书《Sleeping Beauties: Why Good Ideas Go Dormant and How They Wake Up》。他定义“睡美人”为最初获得一些关注、随后被遗忘、最终因各种原因被重新启用并发现其相关性的想法、画家或作者。Byrne指出，灾难（包括战争）是理念被重新发现的重要途径，他重点研究“如何被重新发现”而非“如何被遗忘”，因为遗忘的原因往往是机构傲慢、种族主义、性别歧视或认为比过去更聪明等重复故事，而理解重新发现的机制有助于找到仍被埋没的想法。以明斯基为例，其大部分工作完成于1960年代，思想属于行为经济学，认为人在繁荣时期倾向于假设好时光会持续、增加投资并忽视危险信号，并非总是理性行事。2008年金融危机后，明斯基的“明斯基时刻”成为金融新闻的陈词滥调，但在此之前其思想多被抛弃。Byrne还提到书中涵盖罗马混凝土的发现和《白鲸》等例子。
insights.detail_en: On the Odd Lots podcast, David Byrne introduces his new book 'Sleeping Beauties: Why Good Ideas Go Dormant and How They Wake Up.' He defines a 'sleeping beauty' as an idea, painter, or author that received some initial attention, then faded from view, became forgotten, and at some point was reappropriated and found relevant again. Byrne notes that catastrophes, including war, are a key way such ideas are rediscovered. He focuses on how they are rediscovered rather than how they are forgotten, because the forgetting stories tend to be repetitive—institutional hubris, racism, sexism, or thinking we know better than the past—and understanding rediscovery can help find ideas still out there. Using Minsky as an example, Byrne says much of Minsky's work was done in the 1960s and is behavioral economics: people don't always act rationally, and when times are flush, we assume they will always be, invest more, and ignore danger signs. After the 2008 financial crisis, 'Minsky moment' became a journalistic cliché, but before that his ideas had been largely discarded. Byrne also mentions the book covers the discovery of Roman concrete and 'Moby Dick.'

key_points.zh: “睡美人”指最初受关注后被遗忘、又在特定时刻被重新发现并认为具有相关性的想法或作品。
key_points.en: 'Sleeping beauty' refers to an idea or work that initially gained attention, was forgotten, and later rediscovered as relevant.

key_points.zh: 灾难（包括战争）是理念被重新发现的重要途径；研究“如何被重新发现”有助于找到仍被埋没的想法。
key_points.en: Catastrophes, including war, are a key way ideas are rediscovered; studying 'how' they are rediscovered can help find still-dormant ideas.

key_points.zh: 明斯基的思想属于行为经济学，认为人在繁荣时期会忽视风险、非理性行事；其工作在2008年前多被抛弃，危机后“明斯基时刻”成为流行语。
key_points.en: Minsky's ideas are behavioral economics: people ignore risks and act irrationally in good times. His work was largely discarded before 2008, and 'Minsky moment' became a cliché after the crisis.

key_points.zh: Byrne书中还涵盖罗马混凝土的发现和《白鲸》等案例。
key_points.en: Byrne's book also covers cases such as the discovery of Roman concrete and 'Moby Dick.'

insights.title: Two Power Bills Show Growing US Electricity Price Divide
insights.title_zh: 美国投资者所有公用事业电价涨幅远超市政公用事业
insights.summary_zh: 彭博基于EIA数据的分析显示，2020至2025年间，投资者所有公用事业的平均居民电价上涨34%，而市政公用事业仅上涨19%。马萨诸塞州相邻城镇的案例凸显了这一差距，电价可负担性正成为政治焦点，立法者要求加强对投资者所有公用事业利润和支出的监管。
insights.summary_en: A Bloomberg analysis of EIA data shows that average residential electricity prices at investor-owned utilities rose 34% between 2020 and 2025, compared with 19% at publicly owned utilities. A case study of neighboring Massachusetts towns highlights the gap, as energy affordability becomes a political flashpoint and lawmakers demand stricter oversight of investor-owned utility profits and spending.
insights.detail_zh: 在马萨诸塞州Quinzigamment湖两岸，两位邻居的电费账单差异巨大。Worcester的70岁前医疗秘书Elellanar Rashai今年夏天每月电费高达500美元；不到2000英尺外，Shrewsbury的71岁居民Dave Catz的电费很少超过150至160美元。两人居住的房屋和社区相似，但供电方不同：Rashai依赖大型上市公用事业公司National Grid，Catz则从市政所有的Shrewsbury Electric and Cable Operations购电。去年Shrewsbury的平均居民电价为每千瓦时约16美分，Worcester则超过其两倍，达34美分，且这一差距近年来显著扩大。这并非个例：全国范围内，投资者所有公用事业的电价上涨速度远快于公有公用事业。2020至2025年间，投资者所有公用事业的平均居民电价飙升34%，公有公用事业仅上涨19%。据彭博新闻对EIA数据的分析，像Shrewsbury Electric这样的市政公用事业作为非营利机构，对当地社区负责而非股东，依赖长期电力合同，且没有推高私营企业成本的公司分红压力。National Grid等投资者所有公用事业辩称，其庞大规模使其能够为满足全国能源需求激增所需的高成本关键基础设施升级融资。但一些分析师认为，投资者所有模式可能鼓励资本支出，同时缺乏抑制成本的激励。随着电费飙升使能源可负担性成为政治热点，全国立法者正要求对投资者所有公用事业的利润和支出实施更严格的监管。
insights.detail_en: Across narrow Lake Quinzigamment in Massachusetts, two neighbors face wildly different electric bills. In Worcester, Elellanar Rashai, a 70-year-old former medical secretary, paid as much as $500 a month for power this summer. Less than 2,000 ft away, Dave Catz, a 71-year-old resident of Shrewsbury, rarely saw bills higher than $150 to $160. While both live in similar homes and neighborhoods, they are served by two very different providers: Rashai relies on National Grid, a large publicly traded utility, while Catz buys his electricity from Shrewsbury Electric and Cable Operations, owned and run by the town. The average residential electricity price in Shrewsbury was roughly 16 cents per kilowatt hour last year; in Worcester, it was more than twice as high, 34 cents. That gap has grown significantly in recent years and is not unique to their towns. Nationwide, power prices at investor-owned utilities have increased much faster than at publicly owned providers. Between 2020 and 2025, investor-owned utilities saw average residential prices surge 34% compared with 19% at publicly owned ones, according to a Bloomberg News analysis of EIA data. Municipal utilities like Shrewsbury Electric function as nonprofits accountable to local communities rather than shareholders; they rely on long-term power contracts and lack the corporate dividend pressure that drives up costs at private firms. Investor-owned utilities like National Grid argue their massive scale allows them to finance essential high-cost infrastructure upgrades required for surging national energy demands. But some analysts say the investor-owned model can encourage capital spending while providing weak incentives to keep costs down. With skyrocketing bills turning energy affordability into a political flashpoint, lawmakers across the country are now demanding stricter oversight on investor-owned utility profits and spending.
insights.conclusion_zh: 投资者所有公用事业与市政公用事业的电价涨幅差距显著，且能源可负担性正引发政治审查，相关公用事业公司面临监管压力。
insights.conclusion_en: The gap in electricity price increases between investor-owned and municipal utilities is significant, and energy affordability is triggering political scrutiny, putting regulatory pressure on investor-owned utilities.

key_points.zh: 2020至2025年，投资者所有公用事业的平均居民电价上涨34%，公有公用事业仅上涨19%。
key_points.en: Between 2020 and 2025, average residential electricity prices rose 34% at investor-owned utilities versus 19% at publicly owned ones.

key_points.zh: 马萨诸塞州案例：Shrewsbury平均居民电价为每千瓦时约16美分，Worcester超过两倍，达34美分。
key_points.en: Massachusetts case: Shrewsbury's average residential electricity price was about 16 cents/kWh, while Worcester's was more than double at 34 cents.

key_points.zh: 市政公用事业为非营利机构，对社区负责，依赖长期电力合同，无股东分红压力。
key_points.en: Municipal utilities are nonprofits accountable to communities, rely on long-term power contracts, and face no shareholder dividend pressure.

key_points.zh: 投资者所有公用事业辩称其规模可融资关键基础设施升级，但分析师认为该模式鼓励资本支出而抑制成本激励不足。
key_points.en: Investor-owned utilities argue scale enables financing of critical infrastructure upgrades, but analysts say the model encourages capital spending with weak cost-control incentives.

key_points.zh: 电费飙升使能源可负担性成为政治热点，立法者要求加强对投资者所有公用事业利润和支出的监管。
key_points.en: Skyrocketing bills have made energy affordability a political flashpoint, with lawmakers demanding stricter oversight of investor-owned utility profits and spending.

insights.title: Tesla, Xpeng Showcase Autonomous Cars in Paris
insights.title_zh: 特斯拉Cybercab与Xpeng自动驾驶系统同台亮相巴黎车展
insights.summary_zh: 特斯拉Cybercab首次在欧洲展出，无方向盘和踏板，是马斯克将特斯拉转型为AI巨头计划的关键。Xpeng在巴黎进行其智能驾驶系统的首次欧洲大规模演示，若监管批准计划明年推出。两家公司还在人形机器人领域竞争，下一场较量围绕最智能的机器展开。
insights.summary_en: Tesla's Cybercab, with no steering wheels or foot pedals, is displayed in Europe for the first time and is key to Elon Musk's ambition to transform Tesla into an AI powerhouse. Xpeng conducted its first large-scale demonstration of its intelligent driving system in Europe, planning rollout as soon as next year if regulators approve. Both companies are also developing humanoid robots, with the next battle being about the smartest machine.
insights.detail_zh: 特斯拉Cybercab在巴黎车展首次于欧洲展出，该车没有方向盘和脚踏板，是马斯克将这家电动车制造商转型为AI巨头计划的关键。巴黎车展上并非只有特斯拉的自动驾驶系统，记者体验了小鹏最新的智能驾驶系统，在巴黎繁忙交通中车辆自主完成驾驶。这是小鹏在欧洲首次大规模演示该技术，若监管机构批准，计划最早明年推出。特斯拉与小鹏的竞争远超汽车领域，两者都在开发人形机器人：特斯拉有Optimus，小鹏有Aaron。双方都押注人工智能将远超驾驶领域。特斯拉与中国竞争对手的下一场战斗不仅关乎谁制造最好的电动车，还关乎最智能的机器。
insights.detail_en: Tesla's Cybercab is on display in Europe for the first time at the Paris Motor Show; it has no steering wheels or foot pedals and is key to Elon Musk's ambition to transform the EV maker into an AI powerhouse. The Paris Motor Show features more than just Tesla's autonomous driving system; a reporter experienced Xpeng's latest intelligent driving system, with the car doing all the driving in heavy Paris traffic. This is Xpeng's first large-scale demonstration of this technology in Europe, and if regulators give the green light, they plan to roll it out as soon as next year. The competition between Tesla and Xpeng goes well beyond cars: both are developing humanoid robots—Tesla has Optimus, Xpeng has Aaron. Both are betting that AI will go way beyond driving. The next battle between Tesla and its Chinese rivals is not just about who makes the best electric car, but the smartest machine.
insights.conclusion_zh: 特斯拉与小鹏的竞争正从电动车延伸至自动驾驶和人形机器人，AI能力成为核心战场。
insights.conclusion_en: The competition between Tesla and Xpeng is extending from EVs to autonomous driving and humanoid robots, with AI capability becoming the core battleground.

key_points.zh: 特斯拉Cybercab首次在欧洲展出，无方向盘和踏板，是马斯克将特斯拉转型为AI巨头计划的关键。
key_points.en: Tesla's Cybercab is displayed in Europe for the first time, with no steering wheels or foot pedals, and is key to Elon Musk's ambition to transform Tesla into an AI powerhouse.

key_points.zh: 小鹏在巴黎进行其智能驾驶系统的首次欧洲大规模演示，若监管批准计划最早明年推出。
key_points.en: Xpeng conducted its first large-scale demonstration of its intelligent driving system in Europe in Paris, planning rollout as soon as next year if regulators approve.

key_points.zh: 特斯拉与小鹏的竞争延伸至人形机器人：特斯拉有Optimus，小鹏有Aaron。
key_points.en: The competition between Tesla and Xpeng extends to humanoid robots: Tesla has Optimus, Xpeng has Aaron.

key_points.zh: 双方都押注人工智能将远超驾驶领域，下一场战斗关乎最智能的机器。
key_points.en: Both are betting that AI will go way beyond driving, and the next battle is about the smartest machine.

insights.title: Trump Says There's Zero Chance of Replacing Susie Wiles
insights.title_zh: 白宫新闻秘书五天即遭解职，油价创五月以来新高，中期选举进入倒计时
insights.summary_zh: 白宫新闻秘书Katie Zacharia上任仅五天后被解职，特朗普政府人事动荡持续。与此同时，原油价格升至五月以来最高水平，全球能源供应受到冲击。中期选举仅剩18天，共和党在部分关键选区撤资，前代理幕僚长Mulvaney判断众议院大概率失守，参议院仍为五五开。
insights.summary_en: White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia was removed after a record-short five-day tenure, adding to administration turnover. Meanwhile, crude oil hit its highest level since May amid global energy supply disruptions. With 18 days until the midterms, Republicans are pulling money from key races; former acting Chief of Staff Mulvaney assesses the House is likely lost while the Senate remains 50-50.
insights.detail_zh: 白宫新闻秘书Katie Zacharia在任职仅五天后被解职，特朗普表示希望她过好日子，并称她受到了不公平对待。前代理幕僚长Mick Mulvaney认为她被"安排去失败"，缺乏准备时间，且在乌克兰问题上无法作答。Mulvaney指出特朗普未必需要新闻秘书，Stephanie Grisham在2019年大部分时间未举行新闻发布会。关于幕僚长Susie Wiles，特朗普公开表示不会解雇她，但Mulvaney称自己2020年2月也曾得到类似保证，两周后即离职，他认为Wiles可能生活在"阴云"之下，中期选举后可能是其离任的合适时机。中期选举方面，Mulvaney指出共和党正在从爱荷华州国会选区和北卡罗来纳州参议院选区撤资，认为众议院大概率失守，参议院仍为五五开。原油价格升至五月以来最高，全球能源供应受到冲击，特朗普针对俄罗斯柴油的计划面临两党压力。
insights.detail_en: White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia was removed after only five days on the job. President Trump said he wants her to have a good life and that she was treated unfairly. Former acting Chief of Staff Mick Mulvaney said she was 'set up to fail,' given little prep time, and unable to answer a serious question about Ukraine. Mulvaney noted Trump doesn't necessarily need a press secretary, citing Stephanie Grisham who went most of 2019 without a press conference. On Chief of Staff Susie Wiles, Trump publicly said there's zero chance of firing her, but Mulvaney recalled receiving similar assurances in February 2020 before being gone two weeks later; he said Wiles may live 'under a cloud' and that post-midterms would be an appropriate time for her departure. On the midterms, Mulvaney pointed to Republicans pulling money from congressional races in Iowa and Senate races in North Carolina, assessing the House is probably gone while the Senate remains 50-50. Crude oil hit its highest since May as global energy supplies came under fire, and Trump's plan for Russian diesel faces bipartisan pressure.
insights.conclusion_zh: 中期选举前白宫人事动荡与共和党关键选区撤资信号值得关注，众议院控制权大概率易手，参议院仍存变数；油价升至五月高位叠加对俄柴油政策不确定性，能源板块短期波动风险上升。
insights.conclusion_en: White House personnel turmoil and Republican funding withdrawals from key races ahead of the midterms suggest the House is likely to flip, while the Senate remains uncertain; oil at May highs plus uncertainty over Russian diesel policy raise near-term volatility risk for energy.

key_points.zh: 白宫新闻秘书Katie Zacharia任职仅五天后被解职，特朗普称她受到不公平对待。
key_points.en: White House Press Secretary Katie Zacharia was removed after just five days; Trump said she was treated unfairly.

key_points.zh: 前代理幕僚长Mulvaney认为Zacharia被'安排去失败'，并指出特朗普未必需要新闻秘书。
key_points.en: Former acting Chief of Staff Mulvaney said Zacharia was 'set up to fail' and noted Trump doesn't necessarily need a press secretary.

key_points.zh: Mulvaney判断众议院大概率失守，参议院仍为五五开；共和党正从爱荷华州和北卡罗来纳州关键选区撤资。
key_points.en: Mulvaney assesses the House is likely lost and the Senate remains 50-50; Republicans are pulling money from key races in Iowa and North Carolina.

key_points.zh: 原油价格升至五月以来最高，全球能源供应受到冲击，特朗普对俄柴油计划面临两党压力。
key_points.en: Crude oil hit its highest since May amid global energy supply disruptions; Trump's Russian diesel plan faces bipartisan pressure.

key_points.zh: 特朗普在中期选举前密集造势，已到佐治亚州，提前投票已开始。
key_points.en: Trump is campaigning heavily ahead of the midterms, currently in Georgia where early voting is already underway.

insights.title: Wall Street Week | America’s Relationship Woes, Battery Pivot, Farmers’ Fed Warning
insights.title_zh: 印度新经济论坛：地缘分裂、AI与投资组合重构
insights.summary_zh: 彭博新经济论坛在印度举行，印度总理莫迪警告供应链、能源、矿产、支付与技术正被"武器化"，成为胁迫工具。前美国商务部长雷蒙多强调伊朗与乌克兰冲突推高能源价格、冲击供应链，企业需通过创新与供应链合作适应不确定性。贝莱德COO Goldstein认为投资者不应再依赖单一基准情景，主题（如AI、战争）比资产类别更重要，需持续调整组合。
insights.summary_en: Bloomberg's New Economy Forum convened in India, where PM Modi warned that supply chains, energy, minerals, payments and technology are being 'weaponized' as tools of coercion. Former U.S. Commerce Secretary Raimondo flagged the Iran and Ukraine conflicts as urgent, driving up energy prices and hurting supply chains, urging businesses to innovate and adapt. BlackRock COO Goldstein argued investors can no longer rely on a single base case, and that themes like AI and wars now matter more than individual asset classes.
insights.detail_zh: 彭博本周在印度举办新经济论坛，汇聚政府、商界与市场领袖，讨论日益不确定的世界。印度总理莫迪在主旨发言中警告，曾经连接世界的事物——供应链、能源、矿产、支付、技术——如今正被"武器化"，成为胁迫与施压的工具；他并指出人工智能正在改变各行业的工作方式，多国老龄化挑战加速，当今世界面临的最大问题之一是信任与信心。前美国商务部长雷蒙多呼应莫迪对地缘冲突冲击全球经济的担忧，称伊朗冲突"紧迫"，正推高能源价格、伤害供应链，乌克兰同样紧迫，需要立即关注与解决。她强调企业必须创新、对新经营方式保持开放，并观察到企业为规避关税而增加在美制造、追求更大规模，甚至传统竞争对手开始合作整合供应链，这在五年前难以想象。贝莱德COO Rob Goldstein表示，管理组合不能再假设一个基准情景再围绕其加减仓，世界由地缘分裂、人口结构、技术与资本市场变化驱动，结果是更多"离散结果"；他认为AI、战争等主题比单个资产类别更重要，且这些主题不会等待每三年一次的资产配置会议，投资者必须持续适应，且变化节奏可能继续加快、不会回到过去。印度财政部长西塔拉曼表示，印度多数引资行业已解除此前大量监管，法律更简单、监管更透明且具协商性，人力资本得到加强，经济数字化打开了市场，印度中产阶级的购买力提供了在本土制造并出口的信心。黑石总裁兼COO Jon Gray称印度取得巨大进展，政府改变了资本市场规则，黑石已将多家公司移至印度上市，印度市场流动性如今可能仅次于美国，实体基础设施、争议解决与外资欢迎度均改善，20年前多数行业甚至无法投资，增长因此真正加速。与会者普遍认同最具影响力的变化来自技术，尤其是AI。
insights.detail_en: Bloomberg's New Economy Forum was held in India this week, bringing together government, business and market leaders to discuss an increasingly uncertain world. Indian PM Modi warned in his keynote that things that once connected the world—supply chains, energy, minerals, payments, technology—are today being 'weaponized' as tools of coercion and pressure; he also said AI is changing how every sector works, aging-related challenges are accelerating in several countries, and one of the biggest questions facing the world is trust and confidence. Former U.S. Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo echoed Modi's concerns about geopolitical conflicts hitting the global economy, calling the Iran conflict urgent with challenges reverberating worldwide, driving up energy prices and hurting supply chains, and Ukraine urgent as well, requiring immediate attention and hopefully resolution. She stressed that businesses must innovate and be open-minded to new ways of doing business, observing that companies want to do more manufacturing in the U.S. to avoid tariffs and seek more scale, and that even traditional competitors are working together to combine supply chains—something that would have seemed crazy five years ago. BlackRock COO Rob Goldstein said portfolio managers can no longer assume a base case and then be plus or minus relative to it; the world is driven by geopolitical fragmentation, demographics, technology and changing capital markets, producing more 'discrete outcomes.' He argued themes like AI and the various wars matter more than individual asset classes, and these themes don't wait for a once-every-three-years asset allocation meeting, so investors must continually adapt, with the pace likely to keep accelerating and never revert. India's Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said most sectors drawing capital have been freed of many earlier regulations, laws were simplified, regulations made transparent and consultative, human resources strengthened, and digitization has opened markets, with India's middle class purchasing power giving confidence to manufacture for domestic and export markets. Blackstone President and COO Jon Gray said India has made enormous progress, the government changed capital market rules, Blackstone has moved multiple companies to list in India, and Indian market liquidity is probably second only to the U.S. today, with physical infrastructure, dispute resolution and openness to foreign investment all improved; 20 years ago most industries couldn't even be invested in, and growth has really accelerated. Attendees agreed the most consequential change is coming from technology, particularly AI.
insights.conclusion_zh: 论坛传递的核心信号是：地缘分裂与AI正重塑全球投资格局，投资者应从依赖单一基准情景转向围绕离散结果与主题（如AI、冲突）构建组合，并持续动态调整。
insights.conclusion_en: The forum's core signal: geopolitical fragmentation and AI are reshaping the global investment landscape, and investors should shift from a single base case toward portfolios built around discrete outcomes and themes (e.g., AI, conflicts), adapting continuously.

key_points.zh: 莫迪警告供应链、能源、矿产、支付与技术正被"武器化"，成为胁迫工具，信任与信心是当今世界最大问题之一。
key_points.en: Modi warned that supply chains, energy, minerals, payments and technology are being 'weaponized' as tools of coercion, with trust and confidence among the biggest questions facing the world.

key_points.zh: 雷蒙多称伊朗与乌克兰冲突紧迫，正推高能源价格、伤害供应链；企业为规避关税增加在美制造，甚至竞争对手合作整合供应链。
key_points.en: Raimondo called the Iran and Ukraine conflicts urgent, driving up energy prices and hurting supply chains; companies are adding U.S. manufacturing to avoid tariffs, and even competitors are combining supply chains.

key_points.zh: 贝莱德COO Goldstein：不应再依赖单一基准情景，地缘分裂、人口、技术与资本市场变化带来更多"离散结果"，主题（AI、战争）比资产类别更重要。
key_points.en: BlackRock COO Goldstein: no longer rely on a single base case; geopolitical fragmentation, demographics, technology and capital market shifts produce more 'discrete outcomes,' and themes (AI, wars) matter more than asset classes.

key_points.zh: 印度财长西塔拉曼称多数引资行业已解除监管、法律简化、监管透明，数字化与中产阶级购买力支撑本土制造与出口。
key_points.en: India's Finance Minister Sitharaman said most capital-drawing sectors have been deregulated, laws simplified and regulations made transparent, with digitization and middle-class purchasing power supporting domestic manufacturing and exports.

key_points.zh: 黑石总裁Gray称印度资本市场规则改变、流动性可能仅次于美国，黑石已将多家公司移至印度上市，增长真正加速。
key_points.en: Blackstone President Gray said India's capital market rules have changed and liquidity is probably second only to the U.S.; Blackstone has moved multiple companies to list in India, and growth has really accelerated.

insights.title: Clark Calls for Lower Tariffs, More Legal Immigration
insights.title_zh: 美国商会巴士巡访：企业呼吁确定性、许可改革与降低投入成本
insights.summary_zh: 美国商会主席Suzanne Clark在得州达拉斯的企业巡访中表示，企业界最核心的诉求是政策确定性，具体包括加快并永久化许可审批、降低关税、扩大贸易协定以稳定供应链，以及推动移民改革增加合法劳动力。她同时指出，数据中心等项目建设需与社区共同协商利益安排，而非自上而下推进。
insights.summary_en: U.S. Chamber President Suzanne Clark, on a bus tour in Dallas, Texas, said businesses' primary demand is policy certainty—specifically faster and more permanent permitting, reduced tariffs, more trade agreements to stabilize supply chains, and immigration reform to expand legal labor. She also said data center projects should be developed through community benefit arrangements rather than a top-down push.
insights.detail_zh: 美国商会主席Suzanne Clark在得克萨斯州达拉斯一家小企业Farley参加巴士巡访活动，与SMU学生及商界领袖交流，核心目的是了解企业需要什么样的候选人和政策来推动经济增长。她表示，当天与达拉斯商界领袖午餐时，大家反复提到的是需要“确定性”：企业希望在美国投资、回流，因此需要许可审批改革——更快、更容易、更永久地获得许可；希望边境安全，并推动移民改革、增加合法移民。她还提到降低投入成本的重要性，包括减少关税、达成更多开放市场的贸易协定，使供应链更稳定。关于许可改革，她指出参议院休会前已就此投入大量努力，很可能在跛脚鸭会期重新推进。在政治层面，她提到盖洛普民调显示社会主义的好感度上升，强调自由企业制度才是让人脱贫、规模化解决问题的途径，并希望各级候选人获得亲商公众的支持。她表示不认为总统是社会主义者，但承认两党极端派可能形成有害于商业和经济的政策。关于当前商业环境，她表示企业仍有需求，达拉斯经济繁荣，但普遍面临劳动力严重短缺，尤其是建筑和熟练工种。针对数据中心引发的公众反对，她认为应通过州、地方和区域商会推动社区利益安排，让社区与企业共同参与，实现双赢。她还表示企业对AI感到兴奋，认为这是美国的机遇期。
insights.detail_en: U.S. Chamber President Suzanne Clark spoke during a bus tour at Farley, a small business in Dallas, Texas, meeting with SMU students and business leaders to understand what candidates and policies are needed to grow the economy. She said at a lunch with Dallas business leaders, the recurring theme was a need for certainty: businesses want to invest and onshore in the U.S., requiring permitting reform—permits that are easier, faster, and more permanent; a secure border; and immigration reform with more legal immigration. She also cited lowering input costs through reduced tariffs and more trade agreements that open markets and make supply chains more consistent. On permitting reform, she noted significant Senate effort before the recess and said it could be picked up in the lame duck session. Politically, she referenced a Gallup poll showing rising positive popularity for socialism, arguing free enterprise lifts people out of poverty and solves problems at scale, and said she wants pro-business public backing for candidates at all levels. She said she does not think the president is a socialist but acknowledged that far wings of both parties can create policies harmful to business, the economy, and families. On the business climate, she said demand exists and Dallas is booming, but there is a real lack of labor, especially in construction and skilled trades. On data centers facing public pushback, she said state, local, and regional chambers can help create community benefit arrangements so communities and companies reach win-win solutions. She said businesses are excited about AI and see it as a boon time for the U.S.
insights.conclusion_zh: 企业界对政策确定性和劳动力供给的诉求，是观察美国亲商政策走向与资本开支意愿的重要线索；数据中心与AI相关建设仍是企业乐观情绪的来源，但需关注社区阻力与许可瓶颈。
insights.conclusion_en: Business demands for policy certainty and labor supply are key signals for U.S. pro-business policy direction and capex willingness; data center and AI-related construction remain sources of business optimism, but community pushback and permitting bottlenecks warrant attention.

key_points.zh: 企业界最核心诉求是政策确定性，以支持在美投资和回流。
key_points.en: The top business demand is policy certainty to support U.S. investment and onshoring.

key_points.zh: 具体政策诉求包括许可审批改革、降低关税、扩大贸易协定和移民改革。
key_points.en: Specific policy asks include permitting reform, reduced tariffs, more trade agreements, and immigration reform.

key_points.zh: 许可改革在参议院已有努力，可能在跛脚鸭会期重新推进。
key_points.en: Permitting reform saw Senate effort and could be picked up in the lame duck session.

key_points.zh: 企业普遍面临劳动力短缺，尤其是建筑和熟练工种。
key_points.en: Businesses face a real lack of labor, especially in construction and skilled trades.

key_points.zh: 数据中心建设需通过社区利益安排争取支持，而非自上而下推进。
key_points.en: Data center development should seek support through community benefit arrangements, not a top-down push.

insights.title: Buy CoreWeave's Debt, Not the Stock
insights.title_zh: 分析师：优质核心AI/算力公司债务大概率可全额兑付
insights.summary_zh: 一位分析师表示，其总体倾向是 CoreWeave、Core Scientific 等质量较高的核心算力/加密相关公司的债务"大概率能全额兑付"（money good），理由是这些公司相对于 Mag 7 的市值规模极小，若英伟达或任何超大规模云厂商愿意出手支持，成本对其资产负债表而言微不足道。
insights.summary_en: An analyst said his general leaning is that the debt of higher-quality core names such as CoreWeave or Core Scientific is probably "money good," because these companies are minuscule relative to the Mag 7's market caps — if Nvidia or any hyperscaler wanted to backstop them, the cost would be trivial relative to their balance sheets.
insights.detail_zh: 分析师表示，他总体的倾向是：CoreWeave 或 Core Scientific 这类质量较高的核心公司的债务"大概率能全额兑付"（money good）。其核心逻辑是，这些公司的体量相对于 Mag 7 的市值而言微不足道。他打比方说，如果英伟达或任何一家超大规模云厂商（hyperscaler）想要为这些公司"兜底"（backs top），其代价就像"你买一杯星巴克"一样。相对于这些巨头自身的资产负债表和市值，所需金额是极小的数字，因此它们完全有能力这么做。原文在此处中断，未给出进一步的结论或风险讨论。
insights.detail_en: The analyst said his general leaning is that the debt of higher-quality core names — such as CoreWeave or Core Scientific — is probably "money good." His core logic is that these companies are minuscule compared with the Mag 7's market caps. He likened it to this: if Nvidia or any hyperscaler wanted to backstop these companies, it would be like "you buying a Starbucks." Relative to those giants' own balance sheets and market caps, the amounts involved are minuscule, so they could easily do it. The excerpt cuts off here, with no further conclusion or risk discussion provided.
insights.conclusion_zh: 分析师认为，优质核心算力公司的信用风险可被巨头潜在的兜底能力所覆盖，其债务"大概率能全额兑付"。
insights.conclusion_en: The analyst views credit risk in higher-quality core compute names as covered by the giants' potential willingness and ability to backstop, making their debt probably "money good."

key_points.zh: 分析师总体倾向：CoreWeave、Core Scientific 等质量较高的核心公司债务大概率可全额兑付（money good）。
key_points.en: Analyst's general leaning: debt of higher-quality core names like CoreWeave and Core Scientific is probably "money good."

key_points.zh: 核心理由：这些公司体量相对于 Mag 7 市值微不足道。
key_points.en: Core rationale: these companies are minuscule relative to the Mag 7's market caps.

key_points.zh: 若英伟达或任何超大规模云厂商出手兜底，成本对其资产负债表而言如同"买一杯星巴克"。
key_points.en: If Nvidia or any hyperscaler backstopped them, the cost would be like "buying a Starbucks" relative to their balance sheets.

key_points.zh: 因此这些巨头完全有能力这么做。
key_points.en: Therefore these giants could easily do it.

insights.title: AI Selloff, Oil & Treasury Yields Pressure Markets
insights.title_zh: AI交易遭遇资金成本考验，市场波动加剧
insights.summary_zh: 本周市场出现教科书级关系逆转：10年期美债收益率一度突破5.3%后回落至5.1%以下，油价单日大涨超3.5%，AI交易从不可阻挡的故事转变为拥挤的资本密集型交易。摩根士丹利投资管理高级组合经理Andrew仍持看多立场，认为抛售可能再持续一周，待财报季开启后市场将重新聚焦盈利。
insights.summary_en: This week saw textbook market relationships turn upside down: the 10-year Treasury yield briefly topped 5.3% before falling below 5.1%, oil surged over 3.5% intraday, and the AI trade shifted from an unstoppable story to a crowded, capital-intensive trade. Morgan Stanley Investment Management senior portfolio manager Andrew remains bullish, expecting the selloff to last another week before earnings refocus the market.
insights.detail_zh: 标普500指数本周再度走低，周四的反弹未能持续，同时美债遭遇抛售。10年期美债收益率一度升破5.3%，随后在周四股市恐慌情绪推动下回落至5.1%以下。油价成为当日最大看点，布伦特原油和WTI原油均上涨超过3.5%，午盘油价飙升推动标普500盘中下跌逾1%——对于一个在过去75个交易日中仅10次收盘涨跌幅超过1%的指数而言，这是相对极端的波动。但市场并未出现全面投降：11个标普板块中有7个方向一致，500只成分股中有300只上涨，标普500距上周创下的历史高点仅低2.5%。摩根士丹利投资管理的Andrew表示仍相信看多逻辑，但认为在大型财报发布前抛售可能再持续一周，之后市场将重新聚焦盈利，届时乐观理由将非常充分。他指出，AI股票正像7月那样受到打击，但跌幅远不及7月，因此可能还有下行空间；待财报季来临，若这些公司显示云和数据中心业务增长，将缓解市场焦虑。关于AI建设依赖债务融资的问题（如CoreWeave），Andrew认为这将推动投资者沿资本结构和质量曲线向上移动，更加关注企业杠杆水平；超大规模云厂商已经跑赢，若几周后它们交出强劲业绩，可能引发资金轮动回此前跌幅较大的'卖铲子'类股票。他还指出，与1990年代末华尔街充当'存钱罐'不同，如今华尔街更加挑剔、担忧信用问题，这可能反而延长AI周期，因为产能增长将受到约束。在具体指标上，他关注超大规模厂商的云业务增长是否加速，若加速将鼓励更多资本开支，利好'卖铲子'类公司；同时提到内存芯片供应紧张以及AI芯片每季度'售罄'的情况，台积电等公司处于需求大于供应的局面。但他提醒，这些交易在市场紧张时高度相关、会同步下跌，投资者需保持警惕。
insights.detail_en: The S&P 500 fell again this week, with Thursday's rally proving short-lived amid a Treasury selloff. The 10-year yield briefly topped 5.3% before Thursday's equity angst pushed it back below 5.1%. Oil was the day's big story, with Brent and WTI both up more than 3.5%; a midday oil spike pushed the S&P down more than 1% intraday — a relatively extreme move for an index that has closed up or down 1% only 10 times in the last 75 sessions. Yet this is not broad capitulation: seven of 11 S&P sectors are in agreement, 300 of 500 names are higher, and the S&P is only 2.5% below last week's record. Morgan Stanley Investment Management's Andrew said he still believes in the bull case but expects the selloff to last another week before big earnings reports refocus the market, at which point the case for optimism will be strong. He noted AI stocks are getting hit like in July but are down far less, suggesting more downside; if these companies show cloud and data center growth during earnings, it will soothe market anxiety. On AI buildout debt reliance (e.g., CoreWeave), Andrew said it pushes investors up the cap and quality curves, with more focus on leverage; hyperscalers have already outperformed, and strong numbers in a couple of weeks could trigger rotation back into beaten-down picks-and-shovels names. He contrasted today's pickier Wall Street — worried about credit — with the late 1990s when Wall Street was a piggy bank, arguing this may extend the AI cycle by constraining capacity growth. On metrics, he watches whether hyperscaler cloud growth accelerates, which would encourage more capex and help picks-and-shovels; he also cited memory chip shortages and AI chips being 'sold out' every quarter, with TSMC among those seeing demand exceed supply. But he cautioned these trades are highly correlated and sell off together when the market gets nervous.
insights.conclusion_zh: AI交易的短期波动更多源于资金成本与拥挤度，而非基本面逆转；关注超大规模云厂商财报中云业务增速能否加速，以及'卖铲子'类股票在回调后的轮动机会。
insights.conclusion_en: Short-term AI trade volatility stems more from funding costs and crowding than a fundamental reversal; watch whether hyperscaler cloud growth accelerates in earnings and whether beaten-down picks-and-shovels names see rotation back.

key_points.en: The 10-year Treasury yield briefly topped 5.3% before falling below 5.1%; oil surged over 3.5%, with a midday spike pushing the S&P down more than 1% intraday.

key_points.en: This is not broad capitulation: 7 of 11 sectors are in agreement, 300 of 500 names are higher, and the S&P is only 2.5% below its record.

key_points.zh: 摩根士丹利投资管理的Andrew仍看多，但认为抛售可能再持续一周，待财报季开启后市场将重新聚焦盈利。
key_points.en: Morgan Stanley Investment Management's Andrew remains bullish but expects the selloff to last another week before earnings refocus the market.

key_points.en: The AI trade has shifted from an unstoppable story to a crowded, capital-intensive trade, with investors focusing on debt and leverage used for AI buildout.

key_points.en: Andrew argues Wall Street is pickier and more credit-worried than in the late 1990s, which may actually extend the AI cycle by constraining capacity growth.

insights.title: Warsh Touts ‘Consequential’ AI, Trump Press Secretary Out After Five Days
insights.title_zh: 美股周线收跌：芯片股承压、美债收益率高企、沃什讲话未给指引
insights.summary_zh: 本周美股走弱，标普500周跌约2%，纳指100当日跌2.3%，费城半导体指数跌3%，英伟达、博通、美光、CoreWeave等芯片与AI相关个股普遍下挫。美联储主席沃什在IMF年会讲话中未就货币政策与利率路径给出信号，仅重申将实现价格稳定，并称AI可能是其一生中美国及全球经济最具影响力的变化。
insights.summary_en: US equities ended the week lower, with the S&P 500 down about 2% for the week and the Nasdaq 100 off 2.3% on the day, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 3% and chip/AI names including Nvidia, Broadcom, Micron and CoreWeave declined. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, speaking at the IMF annual meetings, gave no monetary-policy or rate-path signal, reiterating only that the Fed will deliver price stability and calling AI potentially the most consequential change to the US and global economy in his lifetime.
insights.detail_zh: 周五美股全线走低：标普500当日下跌约1.1%至1.2%（跌92点），周线累计下跌约2%；道指跌273点（约0.5%）；纳指跌约2.1%，纳指100跌2.3%。芯片股是主要拖累，费城半导体指数跌3%，英伟达跌1%、博通跌3.7%、美光跌4.1%，CoreWeave再跌12%。债市方面，2年期美债收益率4.74%、10年期5.09%、30年期5.43%；黄金基本持平，报4164美元/盎司；WTI原油升破100美元至100.71美元（涨2.8%），布伦特约109美元（涨3%）。美联储主席沃什在曼谷IMF年会的一场主持讨论中未就货币政策置评，也未更新对美国经济的展望，仅重申美联储将实现价格稳定；他表示AI可能是一生中美国及全球经济最具影响力的变化，并称其将先影响需求端、再影响供给端。彭博记者解读称，沃什刻意不释放利率信号，也未对本周偏热的CPI与PPI数据表达担忧，仅提及9月已加息、取消了“一剂宽松”，并称还有两次会议再作考虑。此外，纽约联储主席威廉姆斯此前表示今年可能还有一次加息、2027年预计不会加息，显示美联储沟通框架正在变化。
insights.detail_en: US equities fell broadly on Friday: the S&P 500 dropped about 1.1%–1.2% (92 points) on the day and roughly 2% for the week; the Dow fell 273 points (~0.5%); the Nasdaq fell about 2.1% and the Nasdaq 100 2.3%. Chip stocks led the decline, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down 3%, Nvidia off 1%, Broadcom down 3.7%, Micron down 4.1% and CoreWeave down another 12%. In rates, the 2-year Treasury yield was 4.74%, the 10-year 5.09% and the 30-year 5.43%. Gold was little changed at $4,164/oz; WTI rose above $100 to $100.71 (+2.8%) and Brent was around $109 (+3%). Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, in a moderated discussion at the IMF annual meetings in Bangkok, made no monetary-policy remarks and gave no update on his US economic outlook, reiterating only that the Fed will deliver price stability. He said AI is probably the most consequential change to the US and global economy in his lifetime, and that it will hit the demand side before the supply side. A Bloomberg reporter characterized the remarks as classic tea-leaf reading: Warsh deliberately avoided signaling rates and did not express concern over this week's hot CPI and PPI data, noting only that the Fed raised rates in September, removed a dose of accommodation, and has two more meetings to consider. Separately, New York Fed President John Williams had indicated one more hike this year and likely none in 2027, underscoring a shifting Fed communication framework.
insights.conclusion_zh: 在收益率高企与芯片股承压的背景下，美联储沟通转向“不给前瞻指引”，市场短期或继续围绕利率路径与AI叙事波动，需关注后续两次议息会议及通胀数据。
insights.conclusion_en: With yields elevated and chip stocks under pressure, the Fed's shift away from forward guidance leaves markets sensitive to the rate path and the AI narrative; watch the next two FOMC meetings and inflation data.

key_points.en: Elevated Treasury yields: 2-year 4.74%, 10-year 5.09%, 30-year 5.43%; WTI above $100 and Brent around $109.

key_points.en: Warsh gave no monetary-policy or rate-path signal at the IMF meetings, reiterating price stability and calling AI a major change hitting demand before supply.
